tooltip.afteros_blaster.crt_blaster.char: Hold use to charge; release to transmit.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.crt_blaster.swit: Shift + right-click: cycle Bolt / Beam / Scatter.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.crt_blaster.terr: Impacts blast craters, fling blocks and light fires
tooltip.afteros_blaster.crt_blaster.safe: Terrain damage is real. Containers and bedrock are spared.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.phosphor_cell: Bottled cyan phosphor. Compatible with the CRT Blaster.
afteros_blaster.configuration.title: AfterOS CRT Blaster
tooltip.afteros_blaster.super.flavor: SIGNAL OVERLOAD. NOTHING SURVIVES THE TRANSMISSION.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.super.charge: Hold use to fully charge; release to transmit.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.floating.flavor: A squad of CRTs that orbit you and fire at anything hostile.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.floating.use: Right-click to deploy. Right-click again to recall.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.lance.tap: Tap right-click: throw a lance (every 4th makes a bigger Space Core burst).
tooltip.afteros_blaster.lance.hold: Hold, then release: a barrage of lances falls on the target. 1 Phosphor Cell.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.lance.space: Shift + right-click: open Imaginary Space. Time crawls, lances rain. 2 Phosphor Cells.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.lance.fan: Fan-made, inspired by Honkai Impact 3rd. Original art, unofficial.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.floating.mode: Shift + right-click: cycle Guard / Hunt / Hold fire.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.tk.flavor: Reality bends to whoever is holding it.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.tk.hold: Hold right-click on a target: lift it. Release to throw it. Sneak while holding to slam it into the ground.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.soul.flavor: Two chained blades that remember every strike.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.soul.tap: Tap right-click: chain whip. Hits and drags a mob to you, or echoes a block into flying shrapnel.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.soul.hold: Hold right-click: Chain Spin, a whirling blade ring around you.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.soul.orbit: Shift + right-click: summon / dismiss the orbiting dual blade rig (1 Phosphor Cell).
tooltip.afteros_blaster.void.flavor: Herrscher Core of the Void. Authority of Space.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.corruptor.charge: Hold to charge, release to fire a corruption beam. Charge sets the radius: 5 / 12 / 25 blocks.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.corruptor.effect: Where it lands the ground is overwritten in waves: black, purple and pink. Corrupted ground slows and hurts mobs. Players are immune by default.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.restoration.use: Right-click: restore corruption outward from where you look. Shift + right-click: a much larger area.
message.afteros_blaster.corrupt_refused: CORRUPTION // blocked (disabled, too many active fronts, or one already here)
message.afteros_blaster.seed_cancelled: SEED REMOVED // the spread has stopped (use the Restoration Tool to undo what it already did)
message.afteros_blaster.seed_armed: CORRUPTION SEED // armed. Everything nearby will be overwritten in about %s seconds. Break the seed to stop it.
message.afteros_blaster.void_walk_on: SPATIAL WALK // space holds you up
message.afteros_blaster.void_in: IMAGINARY SPACE // entered. Walk and fly: every block here is 8 outside. Use the Core again to return.
message.afteros_blaster.void_out: IMAGINARY SPACE // returned to the Overworld
tooltip.afteros_blaster.void.energy: Absorbs Honkai energy from the air and radiates it back. Powers every ability (energy, not Phosphor Cells).
tooltip.afteros_blaster.void.modes: Shift + right-click: change ability. Right-click: use it.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.void.list: Void Step, Portal Gate, Portal Lances, Spatial Collapse, Imaginary Space, Spatial Walk, Void Crystals
message.afteros_blaster.flame_armor_on: FLAME ARMOR // the fire will not touch you
tooltip.afteros_blaster.flame.flavor: Herrscher Core of Flame. The Gem of Destruction.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.flame.energy: Absolute authority over heat. Runs on Honkai energy it absorbs from the air (shared with the Void Core). You are immune to your own fire.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.flame.modes: Shift + right-click: change ability. Right-click: use it.
tooltip.afteros_blaster.flame.list: Flame Wave, Flame Armor, Inferno, Heat Lance, Heat Sink, Nuclear Flare
tooltip.afteros_blaster.flame.warn: Nuclear Flare vaporizes, melts and burns terrain for good. Back up your world.
message.afteros_blaster.resonance: HERRSCHER RESONANCE // Void and Flame together: the lances burn
